The '''Needle Ne-4''' was a model of [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a speedy patrol ship used by high-altitude stations and [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] due to its powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. The craft also saw use in an illegal racing circuit, taking place in cloud structures in gas giants.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Needle is first mentioned in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
